say:2:1230304001:1.text: Not really... We're just guards of the Century Forge...
say:2:1230304001:1.source_cn: 那倒没有……我们只是工坊的守卫……
say:2:1230304001:1.male: Not really... We're just guards of the Century Forge...
say:2:1230304001:1.female: Not really... We're just guards of the Century Forge...

say:3:1230304002:1.text: That's not true! I've chopped wood at the lumberyard!
say:3:1230304002:1.source_cn: 怎么没参与，我去伐木场砍过木头！
say:3:1230304002:1.male: That's not true! I've chopped wood at the lumberyard!
say:3:1230304002:1.female: That's not true! I've chopped wood at the lumberyard!

say:4:1230304003:1.text: Also, we fended off the Water Wights who attacked the Century Forge! That's how we contributed!
say:4:1230304003:1.source_cn: 而且上次我们还一起抵抗了水鬼帮袭击百炼工坊！我们也出了力！
say:4:1230304003:1.male: Also, we fended off the Water Wights who attacked the Century Forge! That's how we contributed!
say:4:1230304003:1.female: Also, we fended off the Water Wights who attacked the Century Forge! That's how we contributed!
